festivals.what: Festival Hoa Đà Lạt lần thứ XI (11th Đà Lạt Flower Festival), 2026, theme 'Đà Lạt: where flowers and music meet'. At a Lâm Đồng Provincial People's Committee press conference the opening was expected on 19 December 2026 and the closing, combined with a Welcome 2027 program, on 31 December 2026. Lâm Viên Square in Đà Lạt is a central venue, with flower displays spread to communes and wards across the province. Dates were still described as expected in October 2026.

culture-cycles.note: Lâm Đồng's own announcement not yet read on a provincial government page; dates come from the provincial newspaper's report of the provincial press conference.
